vocabMixHint: Front shows the word and asks for the translation; back is the reverse. The ratio sets how often each side shows; the order sets how they are mixed.
invalidPattern: Enter a valid ratio (not 0:0) or a sequence of F and B.
exerciseTypesHint: Boosted types show up more often. Banned types are hidden from practice and daily review; nothing is deleted.
reviewLayoutHint: Drag to reorder. Leave minutes empty to split your daily goal equally.
goalHint: Each period you get a menu: new elements to learn and old ones to review. The menu is locked until the period ends; the quantities you save start with the next period. Progress and the full menu show on the language page.
orderHint_random: Each card is front or back at random, weighted by the ratio.
orderHint_alternate: Repeats the ratio in turns: with 2:1, front, front, back, and again.
orderHint_blocks: All fronts first, then all backs. The ratio is ignored.
addTo_boost: Add an exercise type to boost
addTo_ban: Add an exercise type to ban
dragHandle: Move {section}: drag, or use the up and down arrow keys
planEmpty: Default order. Add sections to plan it:
goalActiveDesc: When off, no new items are added to your daily review.
goalDaysLeft: {n, plural, =0 {last day} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
goalShortHint: Not enough unstarted elements in this language to reach the goal. Add more and the goal fills up by itself.
goalCarriedItem: Carried over from an earlier period
goalNoChanges: Changes you save start with the next period.
goalNextPeriod: Next period (from {date}) will use the quantities you saved.
goalReviewShortHint: Not enough already-seen elements in this language yet. Slots fill up as you study more.
goalAutoHint: Follows your daily time when you change it. Edit a number to make it yours.
goalRebuildKept: {count, plural, one {# element kept (mastered or already reviewed)} other {# elements kept (mastered or already reviewed)}}
goalRebuildRedraw: {count, plural, one {# element redrawn from your current numbers} other {# elements redrawn from your current numbers}}
goalRebuildNote: Save your numbers first if you changed them. Nothing is deleted from your lessons.
goalHowTitle: How are the week's objectives split into days?
goalHowBody: The week's menu is one pool, not a fixed split per day. Each daily review takes from it in priority order (new elements first) and fits as many cards as your daily minutes allow: a vocabulary card takes a few seconds, a grammar point a minute or two. Anything you haven't finished carries over to the next days, then to the next period. An element counts as mastered at a score of 60 or more.
goalUnlockLabel: Unlock to rebuild this period's menu
goalUnlockHint: tap the lock to rebuild the menu
